note: Mostly seasonal: of the town park's campsites, six are for overnight guests - Over Night 1-3 (no electric) and 4-5 (electric, 25 x 25 ft pads) on the north side, 6 (tent) on the south. On 41-acre Moon Lake south of US 2; swimming beach and boat ramp; ATVs may ride out to nearby trails. Home of the Lions Club Blueberry Festival on the fourth full weekend of July. --Claude
summary: Town page, rules page and both site maps read: $35 electric / $25 tent (prices 'same as 2024') with $10 extra adult; showers, water, dump, Wi-Fi; season May 15 to the second Saturday of October; reservations through the Town Clerk by phone (page also claims online-only with no link). Only 6 of ~35 sites are overnight. Lakefront -> lakeview.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (mostly seasonal AND iffy; reviewer decides): the site maps mark only six 'Over Night' sites (North 1-5, South 6) against seasonal sites 6-29 (several split A/B, ~29 pads); only Over Night 4 and 5 have electric, on 25 x 25 ft pads, so a 23-ft rig has two possible sites. Iffy: rates posted as 'Rates for the 2024 Camping Season - May 11, 2023 TO October 12, 2024' / 'Base Prices are the same as 2024'; booking contradicts itself (clerk's office vs 'taken online only' with no online link); rules written for seasonals (decks up to 32 sq ft, turf carpet, 'Sub-leasing your site is not permitted'). Nightly share ~17%. For: Google 4.5 (42).

WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview. The camping lawn is separated from Moon Lake by a continuous band of trees along the whole shore (imagery). The nightly sites nearest the water, Over Night 1-3 (no electric, sold by the night) at the lawn's NW end ~46.5571,-91.4074, sit ~15 m from the water but behind that tree line, and the shore row 18-21 is seasonal. Over Night 4-5 (electric) are under the shoreline trees near the beach (~46.5566,-91.4066). No named nightly site has open ground to the water.
PIN fine: 46.5564,-91.4060 is the entrance on County H; the North camping lawn is 50-150 m NW.
PHONE 715-372-5457 (Town Clerk) confirmed. WEBSITE lines confirmed.
HOOKUPS: stored water false / sewer false agree with 'Water is available on both the North and South sides of the campground, but not at each site'; electric amperage not stated.
Old note's 'Reservations online' was wrong (no online system found) and is dropped.
